question: What result follows from sustained participation in Kula knowledge over six months?
premises: There is participation in Kula knowledge.
This participation continues for six months.
inference: Through enjoyment of Kula knowledge for six months, one becomes a recipient of accomplishment.
uncertainties: The term saṃbhogāt may carry a technical ritual sense in this context.
plain_english: Through participation in Kula knowledge for six months, one becomes a recipient of accomplishment.
